sources.title: Kimber Stainless Target II product page (archived 2014-07-01)
LMT L129A1 Reference Rifle (LM308SSR) product page
KRISS Vector Gen 3 Owner's Manual (centerfire SDP/SBR/CRB)

weapons.name: Hunter .308 bolt action, carbon fiber stock, 24" fluted barrel
weapons.source_note: "Twist rate (right hand): 10" and "Grooves: 4" for the .308 Win variant (product # 3000789, UPC 669278307893) on the Kimber Hunter product page. The page lists two variants; the first block with twist 8 (product # 3000793, UPC 669278307930) is the 6.5 Creedmoor, leaving twist 10 for .308 Win. 1 turn in 10 in = 254 mm.

weapons.name: Rapide Dawn 5" barrel, satin silver, blue laminate grips
weapons.source_note: "Twist rate (left hand): 16" stated for the .45 ACP variant (SKU 3000423) of the Kimber RAPIDE (DAWN). 1 turn in 16 in = 406.4 mm.

weapons.name: Target II 1911 5" barrel, adjustable rear sight, stainless
weapons.source_note: Kimber Stainless Target II page: "Caliber: .45 ACP", "Barrel Length (inches): 5", "Twist rate (left hand): 16". 1 turn in 16 in = 406.4 mm.

weapons.name: M110 Sniper Rifle
weapons.source_note: KAC 2012 Military Catalog, M-110 SASS entry: "Barrel 20" (50.8cm) 1:11 Chrome Plated 5R Cut" (Caliber 7.62 NATO). The same catalog calls it the M-110 Semi-Automatic Sniper System (M-110 SASS). 1 turn in 11 in = 279.4 mm.

weapons.name: SR-25 Sniper Rifle
weapons.source_note: KAC 2018 Catalog, SR-25 E2 series: "SR-25 E2 ADVANCED PRECISION RIFLE M-LOK P/N: 31961 ... Barrel 20"(51 cm) 5R Cut 1:10 Twist". All SR-25 E2 models in the catalog (16 in, 14.5 in, 20 in) are listed 1:10. 1 turn in 10 in = 254 mm.

weapons.name: L129A1 Sniper Rifle
weapons.source_note: LMT L129A1 Reference Rifle (LM308SSR) product page, Specifications: "Rifling Twist Rate 1:11.25"" with Caliber "7.62×51 (.308)" and Barrel Material "Stainless Steel (SS)". 1 turn in 11.25 in = 285.75 mm.

weapons.name: Defender-H Rifle
weapons.source_note: LMT Defender-H 7.62 (MWSDFDR) product page, Details and Specs: "16″ 7.62×51 (.308) Chrome Lined 1:10″ RH Twist Barrel" and "Rifling Twist Rate 1:10"". 1 turn in 10 in = 254 mm.

weapons.name: MARS-H 7.62 NATO
weapons.source_note: LMT MARS-H 7.62 (MLKMWS-MARS) product page: "16″ 7.62×51 (.308) Chrome Lined 1:10″ RH Twist Barrel" and Specs "Rifling Twist Rate 1:10"". 1 turn in 10 in = 254 mm.

weapons.name: Vector .22LR Semi-auto Rifle
weapons.source_note: KRISS Vector 22 Owner's Manual, Specifications table: "Caliber 22LR" and "Barrel twist 1:16 RH". 1 turn in 16 in = 406.4 mm.

weapons.name: Vector Gen 3 .45 Semi-auto Carbine
weapons.source_note: KRISS Vector Gen 3 Owner's Manual (covers SDP, SBR, CRB), Specifications tables: "Caliber 45ACP 9mm 10mm" / "Barrel twist 1:16” RH 1:10” RH 1:10” RH". The .45 ACP barrel twist is 1:16 RH. 1 turn in 16 in = 406.4 mm.

weapons.name: Vector SDP .45 Semi-auto Pistol
weapons.source_note: KRISS Vector Gen 3 Owner's Manual (owner's manual for the centerfire Gen 3 SDP, SBR, CRB), Specifications tables: "Caliber 45ACP 9mm 10mm" / "Barrel twist 1:16” RH 1:10” RH 1:10” RH". The .45 ACP barrel twist is 1:16 RH. 1 turn in 16 in = 406.4 mm.
